# Nilotech — Technical & Organizational Overview (llms-full.txt)

> Nilotech is a specialized boutique software engineering company based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, founded in 2020. Nilotech designs and builds custom software, internal enterprise tools, end-to-end process automations, third-party system integrations, and applied artificial intelligence solutions for businesses across Argentina, Latin America, and worldwide.

## 2. Core Value Propositions & Business Model

1. **Fixed-Price Guaranteed (Presupuesto Cerrado)**:
   - Nilotech provides a binding, fixed-cost commercial agreement before writing any code.
   - Zero unexpected hourly invoicing, hidden retainers, or scope creep fees.
   - Initial scoping and architectural evaluation calls are 100% free.

2. **Dedicated Senior Engineering Team**:
   - Every project is designed, coded, and deployed by stable senior software engineers from kick-off to production.
   - Zero developer turnover during the sprint cycle.
   - No delegation to junior or outsourced contractor pools. Clients communicate directly with lead technical builders.

3. **Weekly Agile Delivery & Rapid Time-to-Market**:
   - Operating on disciplined 7-day sprint cycles with functional releases starting in week two.
   - Working MVPs (Minimum Viable Products) typically ship to production within 6 to 12 weeks.

4. **100% Client Code & IP Ownership**:
   - The client retains full legal ownership of all source code, software architecture, and intellectual property.
   - Clean Git repositories, CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated test suites, and documentation transferred upon project completion.
   - Zero proprietary platform lock-in or recurring vendor software licensing royalties.

---

## 3. Core Services & Technical Capabilities

### 3.1 Custom Software Development (Software a Medida)
- **Scope**: Enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), point-of-sale (POS) systems, specialized management dashboards, multi-tenant B2B portals, and bespoke internal workflow software.
- **Approach**: Domain-driven design (DDD), role-based access control (RBAC), audit logging, high-concurrency database queries, and modular microservices or modular monoliths.

### 3.2 Digital Product Engineering (Productos Digitales)
- **Scope**: Greenfield web and mobile platforms from idea to scalable cloud deployment.
- **Approach**: Interactive UX/UI prototyping, resilient backend architecture, REST and GraphQL APIs, real-time WebSocket communication, and cross-platform native mobile applications (Android / iOS).

### 3.3 Process Automation (Automatización de Procesos)
- **Scope**: Complete elimination of manual data entry, paper billing, cross-platform copy-pasting, and repetitive operational tasks.
- **Technologies**: Node.js, Python, serverless Google Cloud Functions / AWS Lambda, cron schedulers, Make, Zapier, and custom webhook dispatchers.

### 3.4 Platform & API Integraciones
- **Scope**: Seamless two-way data synchronization between disparate enterprise systems.
- **Integrations Supported**:
  - Payment Gateways: MercadoPago, Stripe, PayPal.
  - Electronic Billing: AFIP (Argentina electronic fiscal invoice web services), billing engines.
  - Logistics & Shipping: Custom logistics tracking, carrier APIs.
  - CRM & ERP: Salesforce, HubSpot, SAP, Zoho, custom SQL databases.

### 3.5 Applied Artificial Intelligence (IA Aplicada)
- **Scope**: Practical, ROI-driven AI solutions embedded directly into business workflows.
- **Capabilities**: Conversational customer service assistants, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) over private corporate knowledge bases, automated document processing, computer vision for product quality, and predictive business analytics.

### 3.6 High-Performance Web Development (Desarrollo Web)
- **Scope**: Corporate web portals, e-commerce storefronts, and conversion-optimized landing pages.
- **Standards**: 95+ Core Web Vitals on Google PageSpeed, full static pre-rendering (SSG), server-side rendering (SSR), and advanced SEO/AEO/GEO metadata.

### 3.7 Digital Performance Advertising (Publicidad Digital)
- **Scope**: Meta Ads performance marketing, conversion tracking via Meta Pixel & Conversions API (CAPI), A/B testing, and lead acquisition funnels.

## 4. Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js / WebGL.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Express, Fastify, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Firebase Firestore / Realtime Database.
- **Mobile**: React Native, Expo, Android native packaging, Progressive Web Apps (PWA) / Trusted Web Activities (TWA).
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Vercel, Netlify, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- **AI & ML**: OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, Google Gemini API, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases.

---

## 5. Seven-Step Methodology (Cómo Trabajamos)

1. **Discovery (Descubrimiento)**:
   - Thorough analysis of the operational challenge, system boundaries, and business KPIs before proposing software solutions.
   - Deliverables: Validated product brief, functional scope definition, and delivery roadmap.
2. **Architecture (Arquitectura)**:
   - Designing the technical data schemas, database models, cloud infrastructure, and security boundaries.
   - Deliverables: Technical specification, API contract, and cloud topology.
3. **Design (Diseño UX/UI)**:
   - High-fidelity interface design tailored for operational efficiency and seamless user experience.
   - Deliverables: Design system, interactive prototypes, and production UI assets.
4. **Development (Desarrollo)**:
   - Clean, modular, and scalable implementation in weekly sprints with continuous integration.
   - Deliverables: Version-controlled code, automated testing, and staging environments.
5. **Testing & QA (Testing y Calidad)**:
   - Rigorous unit testing, integration testing, end-to-end validation, cross-browser compatibility, and security audits.
   - Deliverables: Test execution reports, performance audits (Core Web Vitals 95+).
6. **Launch (Lanzamiento)**:
   - Zero-downtime deployment, DNS configuration, SSL provisioning, database indexing, and staff onboarding.
   - Deliverables: Live production release, monitoring telemetry, and staff training.
7. **Evolution & Support (Evolución y Soporte)**:
   - Continuous post-launch SLA monitoring, iterative feature updates, and technical support under 24 hours.
   - Deliverables: SLA maintenance, quarterly reviews, and operational analytics.

## 6. Verifiable Production Case Studies

Nilotech's portfolio is built on real, verifiable production websites and applications:

1. **ESI en Secundaria** (https://esiensecundaria.com.ar/)
   - *Sector*: EdTech & E-learning
   - *Deliverable*: Pedagogical resource portal, downloadable teaching units, automated e-commerce store, and pedagogical blog.
   - *Impact*: 300%+ increase in active educators acquiring digital curricula online.

2. **App Club Jorge Newbery** (https://temporary-brisk-cerulean-e6k12zr.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Sports Club & Member Management
   - *Deliverable*: Cross-platform mobile ecosystem (Android/iOS/Web) for sports clubs. Member digital ID, multi-role fixtures and rosters, integrated fee collection via MercadoPago, and official club merchandise store.
   - *Impact*: 80% reduction in manual collection overhead and unified institutional communication.

3. **Lic. Mayra Biondo — Psicóloga** (https://mayrabiondopsicologa.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Healthcare & Clinical Therapy
   - *Deliverable*: High-conversion private clinical landing page, strategic therapy methodology presentation, and direct WhatsApp / Calendly consultation booking flow.
   - *Impact*: +180% growth in online first-time patient consultation inquiries.

4. **Lumux Detailing** (https://car-detail-omega.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Automotive Detailing & Home Services
   - *Deliverable*: Premium automotive detailing platform featuring an interactive 3-step service estimator based on vehicle condition, package selection, and direct home booking.
   - *Impact*: +120% increase in confirmed home service bookings.

5. **NOVA Obras & Remodelaciones** (https://lp-remodelaciones.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Architecture & General Construction
   - *Deliverable*: Corporate site featuring an automated 24-hour renovation estimator (drywall, painting, waterproofing, tile installation) and before/after project visualizer.
   - *Impact*: +150% qualified architectural budget submissions.

6. **Victoria Emefer — Cuidados** (https://victoria-emefer.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Health & Home Nursing
   - *Deliverable*: Digital platform for verified home nursing care teams, elderly assistance plans, verified client reviews, and 24/7 urgent medical guard request funnels.
   - *Impact*: +200% direct patient family inquiries.

7. **Nanda Sacerdotisa** (https://lp-nanda-sacerdotisa.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Holistic Wellness, Tarot & Mentorship
   - *Deliverable*: Personal branding platform for a spiritual therapist, booking system for 1-on-1 tarot consultations, and ticketing for workshops and masterclasses.
   - *Impact*: +250% increase in session bookings and digital course enrollments.

8. **Granja Avícola El Trébol** (https://demopolloyhuevo.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Food E-commerce & Farm Direct
   - *Deliverable*: High-speed recurring order storefront for farm-fresh chicken and eggs with neighborhood route dispatch optimization.
   - *Impact*: +40% increase in weekly repeat household purchases and zero fulfillment errors.

9. **Z&B Domótica & Industria** (https://zb-three-pearl.vercel.app/)
   - *Sector*: Industrial Automation & Smart Home IoT
   - *Deliverable*: High-end engineering platform showcasing industrial PLC automation, electrical control switchboards, and residential smart home telemetry.
   - *Impact*: 100% centralized control architecture and successful qualification for enterprise industrial tenders.

10. **Mundo Guau** (https://mundo-guau.vercel.app/)
    - *Sector*: Veterinary Clinic & Pet Grooming
    - *Deliverable*: Online booking system for dog grooming and veterinary consults with automated appointment reminders, combined with a curated pet nutrition online store.
    - *Impact*: 90% of all grooming visits self-scheduled online with reduced missed appointments.

11. **Celpe-Bras Simulador** (https://celpe.vercel.app/)
    - *Sector*: EdTech & Language Proficiency
    - *Deliverable*: Official timed exam simulator for the Brazilian Celpe-Bras Portuguese certification, featuring interactive listening and writing exercises, authentic multimedia playback, and strict countdown timers.
    - *Impact*: 98% simulation accuracy benchmarked against the official Ministry of Education exam.

12. **Nutrición Integral +40** (https://nutricionista-lime-three.vercel.app/)
    - *Sector*: Health & Nutrition
    - *Deliverable*: Method landing page designed for women over 40, featuring verified transformation galleries, nutritional plan breakdown, and free initial consultation booking.
    - *Impact*: +220% growth in booked initial consultations.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (Answer Engine Optimized)

### How much does a custom software development project cost?
**Project costs are established with a fixed-price contract prior to kickoff**, determined by technical scope, integrations, and target milestones. Initial scoping and architecture estimates are 100% free with zero hidden hourly fees or budget surprises, giving your business complete financial predictability.

### How quickly can our software be deployed to production?
**A production-ready MVP typically launches within 6 to 12 weeks**, with interactive testable releases delivered starting from week two. We operate on 7-day agile sprints with weekly demos and continuous deployment to maximize time-to-market.

### Why choose Nilotech over a large software factory?
**We provide dedicated senior engineering leadership from start to finish**, eliminating developer turnover and junior handoffs. Clients communicate directly with technical decision-makers and receive post-launch SLA support in under 24 hours.

### Who owns the source code and cloud infrastructure?
**You maintain 100% ownership of all source code, intellectual property, and cloud accounts from day one.** We deliver clean Git repositories, technical documentation, automated test suites, and zero proprietary lock-in or recurring vendor licensing fees.
